# DSH A2UI
## A2UI for DeepSeek Harness conversations
DSH A2UI is an independent plugin for rendering standard, agent-generated interfaces inside DeepSeek
Harness conversations. An agent presents an interface, the user interacts, and that action becomes
the next agent turn.
It uses the official A2UI schemas and renderer, with explicit validation, streamed previews, session
-scoped actions, and replay that does not execute past interactions.
See it in DSH · Try it locally · Compatibility · Roadmap · Report an issue
**Development preview: 0.1.0-alpha.13.** Alpha.13 makes clearing either half of a combined DateTimeI
nput clear the whole bound value, so explicit required checks on the submitting Button block empty s
ubmission rather than accepting malformed date/time fragments. Alpha.12 surfaces runtime expression
failures as per-surface, dismissible notices without exposing evaluator payloads or changing action
semantics. Alpha.11 preserves literal model/event metadata through submit and replay while enforcing
disabled navigation at the actual function boundary. Alpha.10 adds native Slider naming and keyboar
d-to-action/replay coverage alongside the accessible TextField view through standard catalog extensi
on APIs. The current alpha.13 bounded synthetic workflow passed in the official DSH Web host, includ
ing native plugin installation, HTTP RPC/WebSocket transport, two-session interaction, cancellation
and restart restoration of authored history. The provider is scripted; live models and complete A2UI
conformance are not certified. This is an additional project, not a replacement for DSH GenUI.
## See it in DeepSeek Harness
The actual DSH Web conversation, not a standalone renderer page: two A2UI surfaces, a user action an
d the next agent turn's preview. **The model provider and workshop data are synthetic.** No live mod
el, real account, booking, payment or customer data was used.
Full-host acceptance run 40204726938 passed on 2026-10-25 at current alpha.13 source `a8744445`. It
exercised the official CLI and Web shell over actual HTTP RPC and WebSocket transport: two isolated
sessions, a controlled pre-admission action failure and deliberate retry, native Stop and recovery,
then graceful process restart and reopening without resending history.
The restored Session B screenshot and full acceptance boundary and retained alpha.8 evidence documen
t that run. Both screenshots were reviewed for privacy and legibility. Authored messages and submitt
ed-action previews persist; **unsent field drafts do not**. This evidence covers the exact source an
d scenario, not all models, components or failure modes.
### Standalone validation and replay demo
The earlier 23-second recording isolates the renderer: invalid input is blocked, a valid action is l
ogged locally, and an explicitly exported recording restores an edited value after reload without re
sending its historical action. It also shows rejection of an unsupported runtime property.
This video is a standalone synthetic page, not the DSH host shown above. It comes from `a8d1170` and
its passing capture run. See the community showcase or reproduce the capture.
## What this project is building
- **Interfaces that participate in the conversation.** A `render_a2ui` tool call creates a dedicated
conversation node. Form actions return to the owning DSH session as explicitly labelled data, so th

e next agent turn can respond.
- **Standard payloads, official rendering.** The bridge uses A2UI mes
sage envelopes and the official basic catalog with `@a2ui/react` and `@a2ui/web_core`. It does not r

ename a proprietary component vocabulary as A2UI.
- **Visible compatibility boundaries.** Invalid sc
hemas, unsupported catalogs, broken surface lifecycles and invalid final component references fail v

isibly. Unsupported features are not silently removed or rewritten.
- **Replay without accidental re
submission.** Portable recordings retain edited field values separately from model-authored messages
. Historical actions remain evidence; importing a recording never sends them again.
The current examples are a workshop request form and a validation form. They are small, inspectable
acceptance fixtures for the larger conversational experience.
## Compatibility and support
This matrix describes the alpha's bounded implementation and evidence, not complete protocol or prod
uction certification.
| Area | Current implementation and evidence | Remaining boundary |
| A2UI protocol | v0.9 and v0.9.1 envelopes; unchanged official schemas pinned from v0.9.1 | A2UI v1

.0 is not supported. |
| Official runtime | `@a2ui/react` and `@a2ui/web_core` 0.14.0 | Other render

er versions and cross-renderer parity are not certified. |
| Basic catalog | Contract fixtures for 1
5 permitted components and 13 permitted functions; separate function-result tests | Full variants, i

nteractions, locales, accessibility and semantic conformance remain open. See coverage. |
| TextFiel
d accessibility | Alpha.9 plugin-owned view using official schema/binder; associated native labels a
cross four variants, dynamic names and explicit validation descriptions | Other component accessibil

ity and screen-reader certification remain open. See scope and evidence. |
| Slider accessibility |
Plugin-owned native range view with associated labels, reactive descriptions and unchanged numeric b
inder | v0.9/v0.9.1 default step 1 only; inherited authored-value sanitization remains. See scope an

d evidence. |
| Literal metadata and execution policy | Model/resolved-event data preserve literal c
omponent/call fields; the renderer denies openUrl at execution as well as authored syntax | Inline a
uthored definitions remain conservative; runtime errors produce a fixed per-surface notice, not atom
ic action failures. Dismissal acknowledges an observation, not recovery. See boundary and workflow a

nd runtime notice lifecycle. |
| DateTimeInput clearing | Either cleared half of a combined selectio
n becomes an empty bound value; explicit checks, action and portable replay preserve that state | At
omic clear, not partial draft storage or comprehensive date/time parsing. See workflow and limits. |

r, not partial draft storage or comprehensive date/time parsing. See workflow and limits. |
